name: Jenkins
description: CI/CD automation server. Monitor build pipelines and deployment compliance.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to your Jenkins server.
2. Click your username (top-right) > Configure.
3. Under "API Token", click "Add new Token" > "Generate".
4. Copy the generated token (shown once).
5. Enter your Jenkins URL, username, and the API token below.

Note: Jenkins is usually self-hosted. The instance must be reachable from CompAI (publicly, via a reverse proxy, or via an allow-listed proxy) for checks to run. The integration user needs at least Overall/Read and Job/Read.

credentialFields.label: Jenkins URL
credentialFields.helpText: Your Jenkins server URL (e.g. https://jenkins.yourcompany.com). No trailing slash. The instance must be reachable from CompAI.

credentialFields.label: Jenkins Username
credentialFields.helpText: The Jenkins username that owns the API token.

credentialFields.label: API Token
credentialFields.helpText: Jenkins API token. Profile > Configure > API Token > Add new Token > Generate. Treat it like a password.
